eval_config.score: RMS spread of the 3 block positions (mm) over the probes after the hold
eval_config.operating_point: per scale, 95th percentile (numpy method='higher') of DEV quiet scores; alarm = score > threshold
eval_config.matched_threshold: quantile of TEST quiet scores at 1 - fpr, method='higher'
eval_config.blind: a fork whose score is below blind_margin x the pre-declared threshold
